audited_revision_note: Freshly reproduced 2026-09-26 against the current checked-in matcher_tla/MatchingEngine.tla. State counts differ from the historical figures in matcher_tla/REPORT.md (recorded at an earlier revision); the discrepancy is real and attributed below, not a measurement artifact.
discrepancy_note: All four completed configurations now generate/find substantially more states than the historical REPORT.md figures (roughly 1.4x-1.6x more distinct states, and 1.3x-1.75x longer wall time). The most plausible cause is the well-formedness-filter hoist into MatchingEngine.tla (WFShapes, ~line 660) and/or other model changes made after REPORT.md's numbers were recorded; this was not root-caused further as it is outside this pass's scope. Both the old and new numbers are preserved here for the record; the paper now cites the freshly archived numbers.

runs.label: 3-order FIFO counterexample
runs.note: Run against the bug-reverted model (ProcessTriggeredStops timestamp-refresh line temporarily reverted: 'converted == ConvertStop(s)' instead of 'converted == [ConvertStop(s) EXCEPT !.timestamp = tm]'). Not an exhaustive run -- terminates at the first invariant violation, so states_left_on_queue > 0 is expected. No -deadlock flag needed since an invariant violation is found before the clock ceiling.

historical_report_md.note: REPORT.md's own '3-order (partial)' row reports 45M+ generated / 26M+ distinct / 10min+ with 'No violation in explored states' for this same config WITH the bug present -- i.e. an earlier attempt at this exact repro did not find a violation in the time it ran. The trace previously printed in paper.tex/REPORT.md was never backed by an archived TLC run consistent with that partial-run entry; it has been replaced by this freshly reproduced and archived trace.

aggregate_of_four_completed_configs.note: Sum of per-run distinct/generated counts across Tiny+Small+Medium+With Amend. This measures aggregate exploration workload, not the cardinality of a deduplicated union across configurations (the same abstract state can recur across different configs).
